svg.title: Rays: degree changes radius, class sets direction
svg.desc: Simulated two-dimensional view of a three-dimensional singular-subspace embedding. Points from three latent classes spread along three rays from the origin because individual degree scales their length. After l2 normalization each class collapses to a tight cluster at the end of its ray.
svg.text: Degree sets length; class sets direction
Faint: raw embedding. Solid: after ℓ₂ normalization.
